model.description: Elevate your rolling experience with Blazy Susan Filter Tips in Purple Ultra Wide. This premium book of filter tips from trusted brand Blazy Susan delivers the perfect foundation for smooth, even sessions. Designed for rolling papers enthusiasts who demand quality and style, these ultra-wide tips provide superior airflow and filtration while adding a vibrant pop of purple to your setup. Each perforated tip is easy to tear and roll, creating a sturdy, reliable filter that enhances every session. Whether you're rolling solo or sharing with friends, these filter tips offer the perfect blend of function and flair. The ultra-wide design accommodates larger rolls, making them ideal for group sessions or those who prefer a more substantial smoke. Stock up on this essential rolling accessory and enjoy consistently smooth draws every time.
